title: Stella & Sola
dek: The sisters whose shop links Pristinia’s ordinary comforts, medicine and emergency care.

facts.Record: Public scenes; later status not established

sources: Main quest-RP archive · message anchors below
NPC Master Registry and Recovery Map · recovery lead, checked against raw scenes
body:
The same sisters, two spellings

Scenes under both Stella and Sola and Stella & Sola name Stella and her sister Sola, place them at their shop and show them speaking together. The shared entry follows that scene continuity, not the account operating the names.

Medicine that must arrive

They ask adventurers to carry a glowing medicine to the healing house in Eovar before it spoils. They distinguish speed from merely guarding the bottle and admit that the doctors know more about the patient’s illness. A delivery request establishes their practical role without proving a completed cure or inventing a diagnosis.

More than a quest counter

They describe their business as a shop of herbs and niceties. They gather materials, prepare a rocking chair for Herb, and later help make beds for children in the shelter. These activities connect healing to the ordinary material care that keeps a settlement alive.

Recorded scenes

  • The herb and niceties shop
  • A rocking chair for Herb
  • Stella and Sola emerge from the apothecary
  • Medicine for Eovar’s healing house
  • The doctors know more
  • Beds for children
